name: SCP: Anomaly Breach 2 [Fanmabe]
desc:
This game is currently in development (WIP). Your core objective is to find the exit.
The best SCP game you played on Roblox!

The game supports two modes: Round-based and PvE/RPG.

iOS users can tap the ">" button to submit commands and use the chat.

Please play fair! Any form of exploiting or glitch abusing is strictly prohibited and will result in an in-game ban.

The game has only two developers, so updates may be delayed; we ask for your understanding.
